evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Framing rehearsal as a precondition for genuinely possessing a capability — security-through-preparedness and mastery-through-practice appealed to in one move.
Cadence decision appeals to stability and security through regular, scheduled practice.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNotPossessed
mints.title: A rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.theme: A capability is claimed as genuinely held only when it has been practiced — unrehearsed readiness is framed as no readiness at all.
